faq.title: ❓ FAQ
faq.q1: Why is Claude Code installation so slow?
faq.a1: May be network issues. Suggest configuring npm mirror: npm config set registry https://registry.npmmirror.com
faq.q2: How to use Claude Code in China?
faq.a2: Need to use third-party API proxy services, or configure proxy. Recommend using proxy services that support Anthropic format.
faq.a3: Official API Key requires registering on Anthropic website and binding credit card. For third-party proxy services, contact the service provider.
faq.q4: What to do if catgirl fails to call Claude Code?
faq.a4: Please check: 1) Is Claude Code installed correctly; 2) Is API Key configured correctly; 3) Is network connection normal; 4) Check N.E.K.O logs for detailed error info.

panel.tip: 🌟 Warm Reminder: This plugin automatically reads API config from N.E.K.O main project and injects to Claude Code, no duplicate configuration needed. If you want to use your own Claude Code config, set auto_inject_api_config = false in plugin.toml
